applies_to: Every book prepared for publication through ABVX-OS

requirements.requirement: Every published book contains an approved reader-facing copyright page. It may not be omitted because the owner did not explicitly request it.

requirements.book_one: Briefly introduce the series/world and the premise of the current book.
requirements.book_two_plus: Provide approximately 0.5–1 printed page of the minimum relevant prior-volume events, followed by a short transition into the current book's premise.
requirements.source_rule: Derive recap claims from canonical/locked manuscripts of previous volumes. Record source paths and SHA-256 values. Do not reconstruct from memory or marketing copy; avoid unnecessary spoilers.
requirements.manuscript_boundary: This reader-facing material is front matter and remains outside the locked narrative manuscript.

status_rules.technical_pass: May describe a technically valid interior even when mandatory front matter is absent; it is diagnostic only.
status_rules.final: Requires TECHNICAL_PASS plus all applicable mandatory front-matter and production gates.
status_rules.kdp_ready: Requires FINAL plus all applicable publication gates; missing copyright page, unknown series membership, or missing series introduction blocks readiness.
